payload.claim: The comment attributes the hyphenated-gate-name reasoning (e.g. `no-network`) to 'Problem item 4 of `SA-0217`', but that spec's Problem section item 4 is 'The graph decides which pages exist' (the id-validation/404 rule) and says nothing about gate names or hyphens. The actual discussion of parsing gate names from `factory:`/`data:gate-` IRIs is acceptance criterion 4, not Problem item 4, so the citation points a future reader at the wrong passage.
